code.text: COAG
PANEL.MICRO

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, pancytopenia (low leukocytes, erythrocytes, platelets), and abnormal white cell differential with monocytosis and basophilia. There is evidence of inflammation (elevated CRP, ferritin, LDH, D-dimer, INR), but no current SARS-CoV-2 infection. The findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible bone marrow suppression or infiltration, and increased risk of bleeding. Further clinical correlation and hematology evaluation are recommended.
